title: StoryLark deployment config
description: Where a deployment lives and how it publishes: origins, the web-push public key, and TTS/narration settings. Set at install time and NEVER part of a portable brand or presentation package — two deployments of the same brand differ here and nowhere else. Every value can be overridden by an environment variable at build time (STORYLARK_APP_ORIGIN, STORYLARK_CONTENT_ORIGIN, STORYLARK_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, STORYLARK_TTS_*), which is how the platform installers set it.

contractVersion.description: Contract major version. The engine refuses a file whose major it does not support; see SUPPORTED_CONTRACT_VERSION in validate.mjs.

appOrigin.description: Where the app is served. Also the base for admin publish notification, and (with the 'app.' label dropped) the marketing origin used to resolve root-relative image srcs.

contentOrigin.description: Where published content is served from (contentUrl() builds asset URLs from this). Optional: empty (the default for a new deployment) means SAME-ORIGIN — the app serves its own content at root-relative paths (/manifest.json, /books/*), with no separate content domain or DNS setup. Set an absolute origin (e.g. an R2 custom domain or CDN) only to serve content off the app's own domain, which lets content requests bypass the Worker.

vapidPublicKey.description: Web-push VAPID PUBLIC key (base64url). Empty disables the push toggle. The matching PRIVATE key is a deployment secret and never appears in any file here. Changing this key orphans every existing push subscription.

tts.description: Narration config used by the publish pipeline.

voice.description: Default narrator voice id — a Kokoro id (af_heart) or an Azure Speech neural voice id.

voices.description: Every voice the library offers. The default `voice` is always included.

sync.description: External content source of truth (AB#7422). Present when this deployment's library is PULLED from somewhere else rather than authored here — a git repository of markdown, or the publisher's own system over a JSON feed. Content that arrives this way is read-only in the admin portal: whoever owns the content owns the edit button. Read by packages/pipeline/sync.mjs; see docs/content-sync.md. NO CREDENTIAL BELONGS HERE — this file is committed. A read-only token goes in STORYLARK_SYNC_TOKEN, and sync.mjs refuses to run if it finds one in this file.

kind.description: Which of the two supported connectors. There are exactly two and there will not be a third: a system that fits neither shape calls the content API instead.

url.description: Repository URL (kind=git) or feed URL (kind=feed). A URL embedding user:password@ is refused — use STORYLARK_SYNC_TOKEN.

ref.description: kind=git only: branch or tag to sync. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

path.description: kind=git only: subdirectory of the repository that contains books/. Defaults to the repository root.
